concerns.text: Execution order states 'T101 ∥ T102' but T102's smoke run executes the existing simulation loop (T028a), which per T101's own description calls save_seed_config — the very function T101 exists to implement (rejected T005b). Running T102 in parallel with (or before) T101 means the loop's seed-persistence call will fail or silently skip, undermining the provenance T109 later depends on. T102 must be sequenced after T101 (or T102 must explicitly stub/guard the seed-persistence call, which it does not state).
